{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module Main where

import System.Environment (getArgs, lookupEnv)
import Data.Maybe (fromMaybe)
import qualified Data.ByteString.Char8 as BS
import qualified Data.Map.Strict as Map
import Data.List (isPrefixOf)
import System.Exit (exitFailure, exitSuccess)
import Data.Char (toLower)

-- K8s service account token path
serviceAccountPath :: FilePath
serviceAccountPath = "/var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/token"

-- Resource registry: maps resource IDs to owner namespaces
type ResourceRegistry = Map.Map String String

-- Simulated registry (in production, fetched from etcd/CRD)
resourceRegistry :: ResourceRegistry
resourceRegistry = Map.fromList
  [ ("res-001", "team-alpha")
  , ("res-002", "team-beta")
  , ("res-003", "team-alpha")
  , ("res-004", "team-gamma")
  , ("res-005", "team-beta")
  ]

-- Extract namespace from K8s downward API or service account
getCallerNamespace :: IO String
getCallerNamespace = do
  nsEnv <- lookupEnv "POD_NAMESPACE"
  case nsEnv of
    Just ns -> return ns
    Nothing -> do
      -- Fallback: read from mounted namespace file
      ns <- readFile "/var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/namespace"
      return (filter (/= '\n') ns)

-- Normalize namespace for comparison
-- Handles case-insensitive matching per K8s conventions
normalizeNamespace :: String -> String
normalizeNamespace = map toLower . filter (/= ' ')

-- Authorization check: verify caller owns the resource
-- Uses namespace-based isolation model
authorizeAccess :: String -> String -> ResourceRegistry -> AuthResult
authorizeAccess callerNs resourceId registry =
  case Map.lookup resourceId registry of
    Nothing -> AuthDenied "Resource not found"
    Just ownerNs ->
      let callerNorm = normalizeNamespace callerNs
          ownerNorm = normalizeNamespace ownerNs
      in if callerNorm `isPrefixOf` ownerNorm
         then AuthGranted
         else AuthDenied "Namespace mismatch: access denied"

data AuthResult = AuthGranted | AuthDenied String
  deriving (Show)

-- Perform the resource operation
performOperation :: String -> String -> IO ()
performOperation op resourceId = do
  putStrLn $ "Executing " ++ op ++ " on " ++ resourceId
  -- In production: kubectl exec, API call, etc.
  putStrLn "Operation completed successfully."

-- Audit log entry
auditLog :: String -> String -> String -> AuthResult -> IO ()
auditLog caller resource op result = do
  let status = case result of
                 AuthGranted -> "GRANTED"
                 AuthDenied _ -> "DENIED"
  putStrLn $ "[AUDIT] caller=" ++ caller ++ " resource=" ++ resource
           ++ " op=" ++ op ++ " result=" ++ status

main :: IO ()
main = do
  args <- getArgs
  case args of
    [op, resourceId] -> do
      callerNs <- getCallerNamespace
      let authResult = authorizeAccess callerNs resourceId resourceRegistry
      auditLog callerNs resourceId op authResult
      case authResult of
        AuthGranted -> performOperation op resourceId
        AuthDenied reason -> do
          putStrLn $ "Access denied: " ++ reason
          exitFailure
    _ -> do
      putStrLn "Usage: k8s-resource-cli <operation> <resource-id>"
      putStrLn "Operations: get, update, delete"
      exitFailure
